The following types of collectors may be installed:
   1.   Flat-plate collectors.
   2.   Evacuated-tube collectors.
   3.   Integral collector storage systems.
   4.   Alternative collectors as approved by the commissioner in accordance with Section 28-113.2 of the Administrative Code.
